name: TheraNest
description: TheraNest is electronic health record and practice-management software for therapists, counselors, psychologists, social workers, and behavioral-health practices. Practices use it for client intake, scheduling, clinical documentation, telehealth, billing, insurance claims, reporting, payments, and client communication.
agentUseSummary: TheraNest cannot be connected directly to Relay agents because Ensora Health publishes no supported TheraNest account API, delegated OAuth contract, API-key contract, developer console, or remote MCP service.

blocked.label: Connect a TheraNest account
blocked.description: Ensora Health does not publish a supported OAuth, API-key, or remote MCP connection contract for TheraNest third-party applications.

blocked.label: Use TheraNest account data
blocked.description: TheraNest does not document the authentication method, endpoints, schemas, permissions, rate limits, or developer terms needed to read or change a customer's practice and clinical data programmatically.

blocked.label: Run TheraNest agent actions
blocked.description: Relay Console cannot collect a TheraNest password, automate its private browser application, or reverse engineer undocumented endpoints handling protected health information.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a supported direct TheraNest API, delegated OAuth contract, API-key contract, or remote MCP service.

runtimeSupport.description: No documented public TheraNest account API or remote MCP service is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No documented public TheraNest account API or remote MCP service is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Ensora Health's current TheraNest product, community, legal, security, export, and integration material publishes no supported account API, delegated OAuth contract, API-key contract, developer console, or remote MCP service. Its official community explicitly describes direct external AI access as unavailable and unsupported, while documented exports remain manual administrator workflows.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Reconsider TheraNest only if Ensora Health publishes a supported distributable account API, delegated OAuth contract, or remote MCP service with healthcare-data terms.

evidence.supports: Ensora Health describes TheraNest as a mental-health EHR and practice-management product for intake, scheduling, documentation, billing, reporting, telehealth, and client communication, but publishes no developer connection surface.

An Ensora Health employee states that TheraNest does not directly support Microsoft Copilot or ChatGPT, does not endorse external AI tools with TheraNest, and supports only Ensora-built AI features embedded within the controlled product environment.

The current official TheraNest community records direct API access as unavailable in a request for programmatic scheduling, balance, cancellation, and inquiry workflows rather than documenting an existing API contract.
TheraNest documents administrator-triggered spreadsheet export for client data plus individual manual note and billing exports; it does not describe authenticated programmatic account access.

Ensora Health's patient-portal terms prohibit technical or manual acquisition through means not purposely made available and require strict credential confidentiality, so Relay must not browser-automate or reverse engineer the private application.
